XIAOMI_USERID.help: 数字用户ID:登录后 go2rtc_homekit.yml 的 xiaomi: 段键名即是

CAM_USER.help: Tapo App → 我 → 工具 → 相机账号 里创建

TAPO_CLOUD_PASSWORD.help: TP-Link 云账号密码(tapo:// 喇叭通道用)

MQTT_PORT.help: 宿主机映射端口(Windows 保留了 1883 所在端口段) — mosquitto's host port, probed by TCP connect

GO2RTC_URL.help: 宿主 go2rtc 实例(小米机必须;见 tools/go2rtc);纯 Tapo 可用容器的 1984

FRIGATE_URL.help: 宿主映射端口(5000 会被 Windows 保留段吞掉) — Frigate listing this camera counts as demand for the stream, so a dead producer is not mistaken for idle

SPEAKER_BACKEND.help: go2rtc=摄像头喇叭 | local=本机 ffplay(开发试听)

SPEAKER_AUDIO_CODEC.help: 喇叭推送编码:小米=opus | Tapo=pcma

SPEAKER_SRC_DIR.help: GO2RTC_URL 指宿主时用 Windows 路径;指容器时用 /cache/tts

PC_INPUT_DEVICE.help: study PC microphone: name fragment, index or default (devices.yml, TD-26)

SUPERVISE.help: add habit-agent (it speaks on schedule) or ollama to supervise them — services the supervisor keeps running (ADR-0016). `habit-agent` is opt-in because the habit coach speaks through the camera on its schedule; add `ollama` when the vision judge is used daily

HEARTBEAT_URL.help: Healthchecks.io check; it alerts you when the PC stops pinging — Healthchecks.io ping URL; the supervisor GETs it every poll (dead man's switch)

GATUS_TOKEN.help: read-only dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:18080 (docker compose up -d gatus) — the read-only dashboard; the same `GATUS_TOKEN` must reach the `gatus` container (docker-compose.yml reads `.env`); empty: no pushes

REQUIRED_CHANNELS.help: checks that alert while a channel is not configured — the `telegram` and `heartbeat` checks fail while a listed channel is not configured; remove one to accept toast-only or no heartbeat

VERIFY_MODE.help: presence=仅到场 | vision=按 tasks.py 里各任务的 verify 策略验证

CHILD_FACE_LABEL.help: Frigate 人脸训练后填孩子名(sub_label);空=任何人都算

notes: 下面三条是 pose_dwell 类任务的全局默认,单任务可在 agent/tasks.py 的 TaskSpec 里覆盖

NOTIFY_WITH_SNAPSHOT.help: habit track only: attach one frame to the parent's Telegram notification (owner opt-in, ADR-0011)
notes: Habit track: attach one camera frame to the parent's Telegram message (images leave the LAN). Owner opt-in, ADR-0011.

PRON_AUTO_JUDGE.help: stays off until the ADR-0011 child-speech evaluation passes — automatic pronunciation judgement; on only after the evaluation threshold in ADR-0011

ASR_HOTWORDS.help: off | lexicon (after the biased-vs-unbiased comparison) — `off` · `lexicon`; on only after the biased-vs-unbiased comparison. P-1 (2026-10-20): hotwords work per stream with `modified_beam_search` and a `bpe.vocab` built from `tokens.txt` (`services/asr/sherpa.py`)

STUDY_BRAIN_MODEL.help: study track: cloud model for enrichment turns (ADR-0003); the habit track keeps its own `BRAIN_MODEL` in `agent/config.py`
notes: Study Brain model (cloud, text only). BRAIN_MODEL above stays the habit track's one-line-phrase model.

BRAIN_TIER_FAST.help: study Brain tier `fast` (M7 design D9, ADR-0017 §5.1): comma-separated backend:model entries tried in order; empty = the tier is not configured; when unset, the legacy key decides (STUDY_BRAIN_MODEL for deep, BRAIN_MODEL_CHEAP for fast); an ollama: entry is gated until Ollama is measured beside the other models (research D10)

BRAIN_TIER_STANDARD.help: study Brain tier `standard` (M7 design D9, ADR-0017 §5.1): comma-separated backend:model entries tried in order; empty = the tier is not configured; when unset, the legacy key decides (STUDY_BRAIN_MODEL for deep, BRAIN_MODEL_CHEAP for fast); an ollama: entry is gated until Ollama is measured beside the other models (research D10)

BRAIN_TIER_DEEP.help: study Brain tier `deep` (M7 design D9, ADR-0017 §5.1): comma-separated backend:model entries tried in order; empty = the tier is not configured; when unset, the legacy key decides (STUDY_BRAIN_MODEL for deep, BRAIN_MODEL_CHEAP for fast); an ollama: entry is gated until Ollama is measured beside the other models (research D10)

BRAIN_ROUTES.help: a JSON override of single cells of the routing table, e.g. {"decide": {"normal": ["fast", "standard"]}}; empty = ADR-0017 §5.1's table with the owner's decide-on-fast change of 2026-10-23 (M7 design D9)

BRAIN_DEADLINE_S.help: overall deadline per Brain call, 1 retry

BOOK_LOOKUP.help: off | openlibrary (ISBN digits only) — `off` · `openlibrary` (ISBN digits only, egress table)

PRACTICE_RETRY_S.help: voice: no retry within this → `unsure(idle)`, next candidate

ANKI_URL.help: AnkiConnect target. Anki can sync your cards to AnkiWeb. Card text can include what Leafi learned from your child's answers. Check your Anki sync setting.

AUDIO_KEEP_CLIPS.help: keep learner audio clips (off by default; see security)

ACTIVE_HOURS.help: Windows Update active hours must cover these hours; free space required on the data drive

ASR_MODEL_DIR.help: sherpa-onnx model folder (`python -m leafi doctor --download` fills `models/` for asr, vad, tts en, pronunciation and ocr)

ASR_THREADS.help: sherpa-onnx CPU threads (P-1: 12-word sentence 0.17 s at 2, 0.12 s at 4, 0.09 s at 8)

BRAIN_BACKEND.help: `claude` · `ollama` (deferred) · `mock`; an empty `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` means static phrases only

CACHE_DIR.help: paths (tests and the no-network run point them at a temp dir)

CHECKS_EVERY_S.help: configuration checks interval (ADR-0016); `python -m leafi checks` runs them once and prints the result

DATA_DIR.help: paths (tests and the no-network run point them at a temp dir)

DEVICES_FILE.help: paths (tests and the no-network run point them at a temp dir)

DOCKER_DESKTOP_EXE.help: Docker Desktop executable for the `docker` recovery; empty finds it next to the docker CLI (scoop) or under Program Files

FRIGATE_CAMERA.help: Frigate listing this camera counts as demand for the stream, so a dead producer is not mistaken for idle

GATUS_URL.help: the read-only dashboard; the same `GATUS_TOKEN` must reach the `gatus` container (docker-compose.yml reads `.env`); empty: no pushes

GO2RTC_CONFIG.help: the go2rtc child the supervisor starts

GO2RTC_EXE.help: the go2rtc child the supervisor starts

GO2RTC_SHA256.help: the `go2rtc-patched` check's expected hash; update it after a patched rebuild (`tools/go2rtc/PATCHES.md`)

KEEP_BACKOFF_S.help: keep.ps1's restart delays and its "crashed repeatedly" rule (window > (exits − 1) × the longest delay)

KEEP_CRASH_EXITS.help: keep.ps1's restart delays and its "crashed repeatedly" rule (window > (exits − 1) × the longest delay)

KEEP_CRASH_WINDOW_MIN.help: keep.ps1's restart delays and its "crashed repeatedly" rule (window > (exits − 1) × the longest delay)

LEAFI_DEBUG_TEXT.help: allow raw utterance text in DEBUG logs

LEASE_TTL_S.help: speech-lease expiry, renewed every third of it

MIN_FREE_GB.help: Windows Update active hours must cover these hours; free space required on the data drive

MODELS_DIR.help: paths (tests and the no-network run point them at a temp dir)

OCR_AUTO_ROTATE.help: when 0° yields < 3 confident lines, read 90/270/180 too and keep the best (the desk book lay at 270°); up to four passes of ~1.5 s once per page

OCR_MIN_CONFIDENCE.help: below it: recapture, then ask the learner

OCR_SECOND_OPINION.help: deferred in v1 (ADR-0011); `qwen_vl` when enabled later

OCR_VERSION.help: `PP-OCRv6` (ships inside the rapidocr wheel) · `PP-OCRv5` (English recogniser, fetched by `doctor --download`); P-3 on desk captures (2026-10-20): v6 gave 6–8 confident lines where v5 gave 1–5

PAGES_RETAIN_DAYS.help: delete cached page images after N days

PAGE_DIFF_THRESHOLD.help: page-turn watcher: mean grey diff (64×64) that counts as motion. Desk camera noise 2.3–3.0, a hand 37–66 (P-3); rendered test pages differ by 1.7, so tests use 1.0

PAGE_POLL_S.help: how often the session checks the Eye for a physical page turn

GUEST_KEEP_DAYS.help: days an unconfirmed guest's session is kept before it is forgotten; 0-30, 0 = delete at wrap (ADR-0018 §1)

CLOUD_PARENT_TEXT.help: parent text (a parent's corrections) may go to the cloud, pseudonymised (ADR-0018 §3, §5)

PRIVACY_TTS_LEARNER_LINES.help: local | cloud — local: a learner's own words and any line naming a listed person, school or term are spoken by Kokoro, never by edge-tts (ADR-0018 §2)

TTS_EDGE_MODE.help: library — edge-tts speaks each prepared line under a grant; the mediated mode of ADR-0018 §2 is not built yet

PRIVACY_NAME_DETECTOR.help: find unlisted names, schools and places in a learner's own words before the cloud (Presidio + spaCy; `doctor` shows whether its model is present)

LOCAL_MODELS.help: backend:model pairs that count as local, comma-separated (e.g. ollama:qwen3:8b); a local backend may read a learner's words unpseudonymised (ADR-0018 §2)

MAGPIE_URL.help: the magpie gateway; always a cloud destination, its port a gateway port (ADR-0018 §2)

HOUSEHOLD_TZ.help: the household's IANA time zone; empty: this machine's

SENTENCE_PAUSE_S.help: voice: silence that completes a sentence near its end (ADR-0013 completion (ii))

SUPERVISOR_BAD_STREAK.help: bad polls before a recovery; recoveries per outage; continuous good time that ends an outage

SUPERVISOR_GRACE.help: per-service grace after a recovery (minimums: docker 120, frigate 60, camera 60)

SUPERVISOR_HEALTHY_S.help: bad polls before a recovery; recoveries per outage; continuous good time that ends an outage

SUPERVISOR_MAX_RECOVERIES.help: bad polls before a recovery; recoveries per outage; continuous good time that ends an outage

SUPERVISOR_PORT.help: the supervisor's `POST /rearm?service=S` listener on 127.0.0.1 (the 🔁 button rearms `camera`); outside Windows' excluded port ranges

SUPERVISOR_RESUME_GAP_S.help: wall-clock gap read as sleep/resume (must exceed one poll plus its worst duration); grace after it

SUPERVISOR_RESUME_GRACE_S.help: wall-clock gap read as sleep/resume (must exceed one poll plus its worst duration); grace after it

TASK_REPEAT_MIN.help: the logon task's repeating trigger (read by `install-tasks.ps1`)

VAD_SILENCE_S.help: Silero VAD (`models/vad/silero_vad.onnx`): silence that closes an utterance; speech probability threshold. Sentence completion is still `SENTENCE_PAUSE_S`

VAD_THRESHOLD.help: Silero VAD (`models/vad/silero_vad.onnx`): silence that closes an utterance; speech probability threshold. Sentence completion is still `SENTENCE_PAUSE_S`
